facts: P17 measurement wrapper single native scalar delegates checked_nonnegative and positive-duration admission; sample_span returns derived elapsed and preserves explicit overflow. No cached unit labels/copies compete with scalar.

Rig-quality garment factory derives PBR from canonical clothing_material::pbr and offset from outermost channel, then retains public material/placement/PBR/offset fields in GarmentSpecification. These derivations can be independently edited via public API; recipient policy must distinguish intended authored overrides from required same-material provenance before promoting inconsistency. Ordinary from_catalog factory is coordinated.

Rig-quality clothing masks/chain bounds/adjacency/occluded-face sets are local derived values computed for one immutable input call; split-vertex weld and normals are separate geometry properties, not a long-lived dependency cache. Repeated skin weighting is same immutable scan policy, no current disagreement established.

Rig-quality body validation checks coordinated vertex extents, joint table count and packed skin joint count before index use. Count equality does not by itself establish rig name/order correspondence; adopted admission/identity findings retain scope. Placeholder output validation admits finite indexed topology and intentionally does not impose armor export quality contract, as authored fixtures state. No generic quality-gate inheritance.
